Select all IC50 activity records in nM for human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL4282). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN required). Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key and docs to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Return columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
